Specification: This module specifies a very small state machine over variables x and S. The initial state sets x to 0 and S to the fixed set {1,2}, and the main action Next requires x = 0, leaves S unchanged, and existentially chooses an n from S in order to compose the actions A(n) and B(n) with the action composition operator \cdot. The temporal part defines Spec as Init /\ [][Next]_<<S,x>>, also defines the same boxed action formula as Prop, and defines Prop2 as ENABLED Next; there is no fault model, fairness condition, proof, or PlusCal algorithm in this file.
